neighbours.label: the unit or last digit that closes a numeric quantity (16 km/h, 1/2 mile, 1558)
fire: The ferry crosses the bay at about 30 km/h in calm weather.
From the parking lot it is a 2 mile walk to the falls.
The tank holds 45 litres and weighs 12 kg when full.
Our cabin sits 800 metres above the valley floor.
The window was resized to 640x480 pixels before export.
The old bridge spans 1/4 mile across the river gorge.
The storm brought gusts of 90 mph along the coast.
After the treaty of 1648, the borders stayed fixed for decades.
quiet: The ferry crosses the bay slowly in calm weather.
From the parking lot it is a short walk to the falls.
The tank holds plenty of water and is heavy when full.
Our cabin sits high above the valley floor.
The window was resized to fit the screen before export.
The old bridge spans the river gorge at its narrowest.
The storm brought strong gusts along the coast.
After the peace treaty, the borders stayed fixed for decades.

notes: Card: scattered last digits and units. Probe: units after numbers ~0.12, years 0.05; weak, likely to fail.
